claims.statement: The three cases are the TOGETHER-SAME row: G pro/pro, H anti/anti, I blue anti with red pro, bound to the live catalog ids tnd-tog-same-gggg, -hhhh and -iiii.
The visitor climbs a ramp to a terrace 2.8 m above the door datum and reads all three cases from above, on a rootbed 5.2 m below the terrace, with no way down.
The payoff is a single eye on the landing half a metre from the rail, from which the three unison figures nest away down one axis and read as one shape at three scales.
Elemental associations are never spoken in the wing. The only text on the shell is the class stamp TOGETHER-SAME and the three case letters.
